name: Publisher Agent
description: Publishes agents, blocks, and workflows to the Maestro catalog. Handles versioning, metadata, and distribution. Ensures quality gates are met before publication.

inputs.name: targetId
inputs.description: ID of the agent/block/workflow to publish

inputs.name: version
inputs.description: Version to publish (auto-incremented if not specified)

inputs.name: preRelease
inputs.description: Whether this is a pre-release version

outputs.name: catalogEntry
outputs.description: The catalog entry that was created

outputs.name: distributionUrls
outputs.description: URLs where the published item can be accessed
